how.title: How it fits your workflow

steps.title: Pick or build a template
steps.description: Start from a system template or create your own with the fields and sections you need.

steps.title: Facts and instructions

steps.title: Export and deliver
steps.description: Download DOCX/PDF for internal sign-off or the client; keep a copy in the account.

trust.title: Professional responsibility stays with you
trust.body: ContractAI is a drafting accelerator. You remain responsible for accuracy, compliance, and risk on the final instrument—same as any template workflow.
trust.bannerBody: Position the tool as part of your stack for first drafts while your standards and sign-off stay in place.

guarantees.title: Guarantees for legal practice
guarantees.subtitle: Clear commitments on data security and how we handle your materials.

items.title: Data confidentiality — strong encryption
items.description: Traffic is protected with HTTPS/TLS; data at rest is encrypted by the infrastructure provider using industry standards, including AES-256.

items.title: Your custom templates stay under your consent
items.description: Templates and documents you create are stored in your account under the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy—you remain in control of the content.

items.title: Exports without watermarks
items.description: DOCX and PDF are built from your text—no service branding watermarks or third-party promo overlays.

items.title: Account access boundaries
items.description: Password-protected sign-in and secure sessions; enable two-factor authentication wherever it is available.

items.title: Clean deliverables for clients and filings
items.description: The final file reflects your edits—suited for internal QC and handoff under your own policies.
